Overview.Name: Renuka K
Overview.Goal: Improve daily energy levels, feel lighter and more confident, and reduce overall fatigue through simple, consistent meals that support fat loss.

Main_Meal: AND Cooked vegetables such as bottle gourd, ridge gourd, beans, or spinach

Notes_and_Tips: Since you prefer one main meal, focus on making it protein-heavy to improve energy and prevent muscle loss.
Avoid very spicy food on late workdays to reduce digestion issues and tiredness.
Finish the main meal at least 2–3 hours before sleep to improve recovery.
On long workdays, keep boiled eggs or curd ready to avoid skipping food completely.
Late nights are a trigger, so keep meals simple and repetitive on busy days.
Drink water regularly during work hours to reduce false hunger and fatigue.
Consistency matters more than variety for steady fat loss and better energy.
